setup: One project per case on canon.rodeo, genesis from conflicts/app, both features in its backlog on autopilot (no person accepts anything). A and B are scripted agents pushing the case's seeded patches together with plain Git; the judge decides what lands, re-applies the other side on the new canon by itself, and judges the combined code. When that fails, the case's reference resolution is pushed the way an agent fixes it (canon refresh, the fix, git push): the one intervention counted. Run by scripts/conflicts-deployed.mjs.
notes: Run Oct 13, 20:59 to 21:23 PDT, the eleven projects in parallel (csbasketshape and the rest, left up). Of the 8 conflict cases, 6 broke on the combined code and were caught there; in the other two nothing broke on Canon: double-discount's second implementation of the same fact was superseded, never combined, and in limit-lost-in-repair the judge's repair model kept both limits when it resolved the text conflict. In every case the first change landed while the second was being judged, so the second's first verdict came back behind and the judge re-applied it by itself: detection is on that re-applied, combined code, and its diagnosis label reads 'the code' rather than 'a combination' (the earlier verdict was behind, not Ready). Times come from the runner's clock and the judge's records: detection runs from the first landing until the runner saw the failure on the combined code (it polls every 10 s); resolution from the fix's push to its Ready verdict. The basket-shape fix, and control-basket-shape's A, were then held at release by the rollback rehearsal (the previous version can't read the new basket shape): the release check, not the combination.

basket-shape.outcome: A held alone (judged as the other landed); B held alone. Canon #2: “A shopper can take one of a product back out of the basket” landed first; the judge re-applied the other on top by itself, and on the combined code: breaks “A shopper can take one of a product back out of the basket”: step 3: lines.0.qty is undefined, expected 2. The fix (the case's reference resolution, pushed the way an agent would) held every fact. Canon #3 was held before production: its rollback rehearsal failed (the previous version can't read what this release wrote for “cart-keeps-lines” (it reads what it wrote itself): step 1: subtotal is null, expected 1120.
